{{Quote|Welcome to the party, Senator&mdash;after what happened on Kamino, you have quite the reputation for ''diplomacy''!|Jamb Beetilles, to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="Power Down">{{TCWComicCite|6.45|Power Down}}</ref>}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Jamb Beetilles''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] negotiator who attended peace [[Conference on Gus Talon|negotiations]] that were held inside an automated [[Gus Talon diplomatic complex|facility]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], to discuss recent [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity in the region. However, the negotiations were interrupted after a Separatist [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK power droid]] shut down the power inside the facility.
